guards.all_mutations: Require authorized context, expected aggregate version, and current lease epoch where a worker owns the transition.
guards.run_to_succeeded: No pending inputs or unresolved effects; all required acceptance evidence has been committed and validated.
guards.run_to_terminal: No unresolved external effects. Expiry/cancellation intent may remain while blocked until reconciled.
guards.cancel_race: The first committed aggregate transition wins. A committed cancellation prevents new business dispatch.
guards.action_to_cancelled: Pre-dispatch cancellation or confirmed external execution stop. A mere cancellation acknowledgement is insufficient.
guards.unknown_to_ready: Trusted reconciliation proves not-applied OR verified downstream idempotency still applies; never an LLM guess.
guards.waiting_input_to_ready: Bound input/approval received, not expired, same request hash and scope; dispatch revalidates authorization.
guards.running_to_retry_wait: Effect classification and dispatch evidence establish a safe retry, budget/deadline permit it.
